crossRefs.note: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

translations.web: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.
translations.bsb: But ten of the men among them said to Ishmael, “Do not kill us, for we have hidden treasure in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey!” So he refrained from killing them with the others.
translations.kjv: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
translations.asv: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
